```yaml
name: Validate Dotfiles

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Fish, Zsh, and Stow
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y fish zsh stow

      - name: Run shellcheck
        uses: luizm/action-sh-checker@v1
        with:
          sh_checker_exclude: ''
          sh_checker_shfmt_disable: true
          sh_checker_shellcheck_disable: false
          sh_checker_checkbashisms_enable: true
          sh_checker_comment: true
          sh_checker_only_diff: false

      - name: Run validation scripts
        run: |
          #!/usr/bin/env bash
          set -euo pipefail

          echo "=== Fish syntax checks ==="
          find . -name '*.fish' -print0 | xargs -0 -I{} fish --syntax-check {} || { echo "Fish syntax errors found"; exit 1; }

          echo "=== Zsh syntax checks ==="
          zsh -n ~/.zshrc || { echo "Zsh syntax error in ~/.zshrc"; exit 1; }

          echo "=== Shared configuration integrity ==="
          if [ -f scripts/check_shared.sh ]; then
            bash scripts/check_shared.sh || { echo "Shared config integrity check failed"; exit 1; }
          fi

          echo "=== Abbreviation consistency ==="
          if [ -f scripts/check_abbreviations.sh ]; then
            bash scripts/check_abbreviations.sh || { echo "Abbreviation consistency check failed"; exit 1; }
          fi

          echo "=== Environment variable conflicts ==="
          if [ -f scripts/check_env_conflicts.sh ]; then
            bash scripts/check_env_conflicts.sh || { echo "Environment variable conflict detected"; exit 1; }
          fi

          echo "=== Symlink integrity ==="
          if find . -xtype l | grep -q .; then
            echo "Broken symlinks detected:"
            find . -xtype l
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "=== Dependency availability ==="
          if [ -f scripts/check_dependencies.sh ]; then
            bash scripts/check_dependencies.sh || { echo "Dependency check failed"; exit 1; }
          fi

          echo "All validation checks passed."
```
